अग्नायी (यी) 3.
f. The goddess of
fire; the Tretā yug or second
age.

अग्नि (ग्निः) 2.
m. God of fire; bile.

अग्निक (कः) 1.
m. An insect of a
scarlet colour, the lady-bird.

अग्नि-कण (णः) 1.
m. A spark.

अग्नि-कारिका (का) 1.
f. The main-
taining of a sacrificial fire.

अग्नि-कार्य्य (र्य्य) 1.
n. Idem.

अग्नि-काष्ठ (ष्ठं) 1.
n. Agallochum.

अग्नि-कुक्कुट (टः) 1.
m. A firebrand.

अग्नि-कृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Made by
fire, offered by fire.

अग्नि-कोण (णः) 1.
m. The east.

अग्नि-क्रीडा (डा) 1.
f. Fireworks.

अग्नि-गर्भ (र्भः) 1.
m. A crystal;
f.
(भा) the sun-stone; a plant.

अग्नि-चित् (त्) 1.
m. One who has
consecrated the sacrificial fire.

अग्नि-चित्या (त्या) 1.
f. The main-
taining of a sacrificial fire.

अग्नि-ज (जः or जातः- or जारः or
जालः) 1.
m. A plant of stimulant
properties;
a. Produced by fire.

अग्नि-जिह्वा (ह्वा) 1.
f. Medicinal
plant.

अग्नि-ज्वाला (ला) 1.
f. A plant
(Grislea tomentosa); flame of
fire.

अग्नि-त्रेता (ता) 1.
f. The three fires
of a brāhman householder^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

अग्नि-दमनी (नी) 3.
f. A medicinal
plant of narcotic properties.

अग्नि-दग्ध (ग्धः) 1.
m. Progenitor
to whom offerings are made;
a.
Burnt.

अग्नि-दीप्ता (प्ता) 1.
f. The name of a
plant;
a. Blazing; digestive.

अग्नि-दूषित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Branded.

अग्नि-देवा (वा) 1.
f. The Pleiades.

अग्नि-निर्य्यास (सः) 1.
m. Name of a
plant. Also अग्निजारः

अग्नि-परीक्षा (क्षा) 1.
f. Fiery trial.

अग्नि-प्रस्तर (रः) 1.
m. A flint.

अग्निभ (भः) 1.
m. Gold.

अग्नि-भू (भूः) 3.
m. A name of Scan-
da, or the Hindu Mars; 2.
n.
(भु) water.

अग्नि-भूति (तिः) 2.
m. Name of a
sage.

अग्नि-मणि (णिः) 2.
m. The sun-
stone.

अग्निमत् (मान्-मती-मत्)
a. Having a
fire or a consecrated one; fiery.

अग्नि-मन्थ (न्थः) 1.
m. A shrub
(Premna spinosa).

अग्नि-मारुति (तिः) 1.
m. A name of
the sage Agastya.

अग्नि-मुख (खः) 1.
m. A deity; a
brāhman; a plant; a marking
nut.

अग्नि-रक्षण (णं) 1.
n. The constant
maintenance of a sacred fire.

अग्नि-रजस् (जाः) 5.
m. An insect
of a scarlet color, lady-bird.

अग्नि-रुहा (हा) 1.
f. Name of a
plant.

अग्नि-वर्ण (णः-णा-णं)
a. Hot, fiery.

अग्नि-वर्द्धन (नः) 1.
n. Exciting fire;
(नः)
m. stomachic.

अग्नि-बल्लभ (भः) 1.
m. Resin.

अग्नि-बाण (णः) 1.
m. Fiery dart.

अग्नि-बाह (हः) 1.
m. Smoke.

अग्नि-बाहु (हुः) 2.
m. Smoke.

अग्नि-विसर्प (पः) 1.
m. Pain caused
by inflammation.

अग्नि-वीज (जं) 1.
n. Gold.

अग्नि-वीर्य्य (र्य्यं) 1.
n. Gold.

अग्नि-शिख (खः-खं) 1.
m. n. Saffron;
m. Lamp; arrow; rocket; 1.
f. (खा) flame.

अग्नि-शेखर (रं) 1.
n. Saffron.

अग्नि-ष्टुत् (त्) 5.
f. Expiatory sacri-
fice.

अग्नि-ष्टोम (मः) 1.
m. Particular sa-
crifices to fire made for five days
in the spring season.

अग्नि-ष्ठ (ष्ठं) 1.
n. An iron frying-
pan.

अग्नि-ष्वात्त (त्तः) 1.
m. Demigods,
sons of
Marichi, or manes to
whom offerings are made.

अग्नि-सख (खः) 1.
m. The wind.

अग्नि-सम्भव (वः) 1.
m. Wild saffron.

अग्निसार (रं) 1.
n. A collyrium.

अग्नि-होत्र (त्रं) 1.
n. The perpetual
maintenance of a sacred fire.

अग्नि-होत्र (त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
a. Intended for
or connected with the mainte-
nance of the perpetual fire.

अग्नि-होत्रिन् (त्री) 5.
m. One who
maintains a perpetual sacred fire.

अग्नी_ध् (त्) 5.
m. A priest who at-
tends the fire. Also अग्नीध्रः.

अग्नी_न्धन (न) 1.
n. The kindling of
a sacrificial fire.

अग्न्या_धान (नं) 1.
n. Maintenance
of a perpetual sacred fire.

अग्न्या_लय (यः) 1.
m. The place of
consecrated fire. Also अग्न्यागारः.

अग्न्यु_त्पात (तः) 1.
m. A fiery me-
teor.

आग्नी_ध्र (ध्रं) 1.
n. A place where
the sacrificial fire is kindled.

आग्नेय (यं) 1.
n. Name of a city and
of a person; blood; ghee.
a. Be-
longing to fire or its deity.

आग्नेयी (यी) 3.
f. Wife of Agni, or
his place of residence.
